title: Washington Monument
summary: The Washington Monument is an obelisk in Washington, D.C. Its cornerstone was laid on 4 July 1848; work stopped in 1854 with the column at 152 feet, and the capstone was set on 6 December 1884. The National Park Service gives its height as 555 feet 5 1/8 inches.

uncertainty.note: Start is the cornerstone of 4 July 1848; end is the capstone of 6 December 1884. Work paused from 1854 until Congress voted to resume in 1876. The monument stands.
